programme.title: Computer Science BSc
programme.degree: BSc (single honours), 3 years full-time, UCAS G400, start September 2027
programme.how_found: kcl.ac.uk undergraduate course finder -> Computer Science BSc; entry requirements on the course's /entry-requirements subpage; English bands, deadline and fees on the university-wide undergraduate pages.
programme.notes: The course page's fee block and application deadline are filled in client-side (empty 'Application deadline:' and no fee figures in the served HTML of the page or its /fees subpage).

english.quote: IELTS (Academic) 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each skill
english.notes: Band D (course page /entry-requirements: 'English language band: D'; Band D applies to the 'Faculty of Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences', which teaches Computer Science BSc). The same IELTS line appears under one other band on the page, so the band link is in these notes, not the quote. Band D also: PTE Academic 62 overall, 59 each skill; Cambridge C1/C2 176 overall, 169 each skill. Tests valid within two years of 1 September 2027.

value.description: No GPA threshold; qualification grades: A-levels A*A*A incl. A in Mathematics or Further Mathematics; IB 39 points (or 20 from three HL) with HL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches 6; other international qualifications via a country selector.

gpa.quote: 39 points overall or an aggregate score of 20 from three Higher Levels.
gpa.notes: Country-specific equivalents are loaded through an interactive selector and were not read.

deadline.quote: The standard deadline for applications is 13 January 2027 18:00 (UK time)
deadline.notes: 18:00 UK time, via UCAS. Same page: 'The UCAS website states a more flexible deadline for international students, however, any application received by King's after the above dates is considered late.' So the date applies to international applicants too.

tuition.notes: International fee not published in the served HTML: the course page and /fees subpage render the fee block client-side; the university page /study/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/tuition-fees gives only the Home fee ('Home fees for students based in the UK are set at £9,790 for new students starting in September 2026.') and says 'All tuition fees can be found on each individual course page'.

scholarship_exists.notes: No entry scholarship for an international undergraduate found. The King's funding database lists the Sanctuary Scholarship 2026-27 (for asylum seekers/displaced people, and only for 'an in-person, one year programme at King's') and the International Hardship Fund 2026-27 (hardship support for enrolled International and EU students, not an entry award). Neither applies to a 3-year BSc applicant.

scholarship_international.notes: No undergraduate entry scholarship identified; see scholarship_exists.
